projects.name: TRICORDER
projects.first_demonstrator: Modular portable environmental sensor platform measuring temperature, humidity, pressure, light, and selected air-quality indicators.
acceptance: Sensor readings include units, timestamps, device identity, and calibration metadata.
Readings are compared against a reference instrument with error documented.
Missing, stale, and out-of-range readings are explicitly flagged.
Core acquisition and local display function without internet access.
projects.safety: Use low-voltage modules; gas and water quality claims require sensor-specific validation and must not be represented as certified safety measurements.

projects.name: ALFRED FIELD SYSTEM
projects.first_demonstrator: Human-supervised voice and mobile interface for approved sensor and robot workflows.
acceptance: Explicit user confirmation for consequential actions.
Offline-safe fallback and visible connectivity status.
Audit log of commands and device responses.
projects.safety: No autonomous hazardous actuation; authentication and authorization required.

projects.name: SENTINEL
projects.first_demonstrator: Low-power environmental sensor node with local buffering and dashboard.
acceptance: Documented sampling interval and power budget.
Store-and-forward behavior during network loss.
Sensor calibration and health status visible.
projects.safety: Monitoring only; alerts are advisory until validated.

projects.name: ATLAS
projects.first_demonstrator: Small indoor mobile robot with teleoperation, obstacle detection, emergency stop, and bounded test area.
acceptance: Emergency stop halts motion reliably in test conditions.
Speed and operating area are bounded.
Manual override remains available.
projects.safety: No public-road operation or unsupervised operation around people.

projects.name: AEGIS
projects.first_demonstrator: Wearable environmental exposure logger with non-medical status display.
acceptance: Sensor limits and uncertainty are displayed.
No medical diagnosis or protective certification claims.
Alerts are traceable to sensor readings.
projects.safety: Not personal protective equipment certification or a substitute for approved monitors.

projects.name: HOLODECK
acceptance: Scene data and units are documented.
Simulation assumptions are visible.
Visual output is distinguished from measured physical reality.
projects.safety: No safety-critical decisions from unvalidated simulation.

projects.name: PROMETHEUS
projects.first_demonstrator: Instrumented low-voltage solar and battery monitoring demonstrator.
acceptance: Power, energy, and efficiency calculations independently checked.
Battery protection and safe operating limits documented.
No grid connection in initial prototype.
projects.safety: Qualified review required before high-voltage, mains, or grid-connected work.

projects.name: EDEN
projects.first_demonstrator: Small automated growing enclosure with temperature, humidity, light, and soil-moisture sensing.
acceptance: Environmental data logged.
Control outputs have safe bounds and manual override.
Plant outcomes measured against a baseline.
projects.safety: Water/electrical separation and food-safety requirements reviewed.

projects.name: FORGE
projects.first_demonstrator: AI-assisted CAD review, fabrication planning, and dimensional inspection workflow.
acceptance: Human approves machine instructions before execution.
Design files and material settings are versioned.
Inspection uncertainty and tolerances documented.
projects.safety: No autonomous machine operation without guarding, interlocks, and risk assessment.

projects.name: ORBIT
projects.first_demonstrator: Simulation of autonomous exploration, resource mapping, and power-constrained mission planning.
acceptance: Physics and environmental assumptions documented.
Simulation outputs reproducible from versioned inputs.
Simulated performance never represented as flight-qualified.
projects.safety: Simulation-first; no launch or flight hardware implied.
